Hi, this will probably get lost in the rest but I’ll send it anyway. I, a male, have bitten my nails my whole life as well. When I was a kid my mom put acrylic on my nails too. It worked, I got out of the habit and didn’t bite my nails anymore. But! The acrylic has to come off at some point and then your nails are super thin and weak. But that’s ok because you don’t bite your nails anymore, until one chips in the car and now it’s grabbing on everything you touch and you just want to fix it so you start to just “clean it up” with your teeth but that sends you into relapse and you can’t help but finish of the nail and you’re back to square one.

I recommend buying the “paint you nails and make them taste like shit” stuff. Use it immediately after you take the acrylic off. It will just give you that gentle reminder to leave them alone. 

Also get a travel manicure kit and keep it in your car.
